calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-02-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Present: Petitrioner Jacob Andrew Lawton; Judge: Ollie Marie-Victoire; Clerk: Craig Blackstone; Reporter: Valelrie Papale. Petitioner was sworn and testified. Petitioner provided to Court evidence of publication, and orally moved to amend petition to include change of gender. Upon satisfactory proof being made, the Court entered decree that Petitioner's name be changed from Jacob Andrew Lawton to Rachel Mary Lawton, and that Petitioner's gender be changed from male to female. (D. 505)
